concerns.text: The specification assumes that a single canonical source (Materials Project) provides at least 1,000 2D material entries with complete 6‑component elastic tensors, but no verification of this dataset’s coverage is presented. If the source lacks sufficient 2D entries, the entire pipeline (SC‑001 through SC‑006) cannot be executed, making the research plan infeasible.

SC‑002 defines a “chemical family” as a combination of space‑group and cation‑anion stoichiometry, while the split generator (referenced in the implementation plan) uses StructureMatcher clustering to create splits. Because StructureMatcher can merge structures across space groups, the split may not respect the family definition, risking data leakage between train and test sets and invalidating the claim of out‑of‑family generalization.
